reviews.text: We took our 8-month-old red toy poodle for his first grooming experience: a specific cut we chose, a trim, nail clipping, a bath, and even ear cleaning. He received special treatment with lots of love and attention. Even though he's a very energetic puppy, he calmed down in Thiago's presence. We were apprehensive about the result of the cut since it was his first time, but in the end, we were very pleasantly surprised; it turned out better than we imagined! Now our beautiful, fragrant puppy is well-groomed thanks to the great professional that Thiago is. We will definitely return many more times!
My puppies look great after their grooming! I was very happy! I received excellent service. You've gained a customer. ☺️
I highly recommend him! Thiago is super friendly and attentive.
